touches.subject: CFO Stack
touches.body:
Hi Aditya,

Saw the CFO Stack launch: Virtual Accounts confirm corporate transfers in real time.

My guess is the tricky transfers look fine everywhere: in at the bank, received on the account, yet the invoice is still open.

We've built software that follows each transaction across systems and catches the ones that never really closed, even when every system says they're fine. The interesting part is what to build on top, and we'd rather shape it with a few payments teams on real data than guess.

For HitPay, that could mean putting a month of transfers through it before committing engineers, and seeing which looked done but never closed.

Worth trying on transfers, or another part of CFO Stack?

Ilia Frolov
CRO & Product Architect, HAIA
haia.finance

Aditya, saw the CFO Stack launch. My guess is the tricky transfers look fine everywhere, yet the invoice behind them is still open. We've built software that catches transactions that never really closed, even when every system says they're fine, and we're shaping what comes next with a few payments teams. Worth trying on a month of your transfers, or is another part of CFO Stack a better fit?

Ilia

Hi Aditya,

Another angle: UPI (INR), launched on 30 October for merchants outside India. T+5 settlement into the merchant's home currency is where "where is my money" questions start on a new rail.

Once a few weeks of UPI settlements are in, we could run them through the same software and show which ran late and why.

Is UPI a better place to start than unmatched transfers?

Ilia

Aditya, a question rather than a pitch. With supplier payments and payroll next on the CFO Stack roadmap, money starts leaving through Virtual Accounts, not just arriving. Outgoing flows bring their own exceptions: a payout the bank returns needs an owner as much as an unmatched transfer does. Are you designing for that now, or later? I emailed you a short note on it.

Ilia

Aditya, closing the loop on my notes. If payment operations sit with someone else day to day, who would be best to ask? Happy to take it from there.

Ilia
